title: Chapter Number New Jersey
subtitle: A chapter that is, so far, entirely a title.

infobox.Printed title: Chaper Number New Jersey, the newest jersey, dare I say the most modern jersey I have seen yet, believe me I've seen alot of jerseys and none are as meta as this jersey
infobox.Storylines: None yet. The heroes were last seen heading for [[new-jersey-system|the New Jersey system]]

lead: **Chapter Number New Jersey** is the ninth chapter heading of *The Legend of Chris*, added to the MASTER FILE in the October 2026 update. At the time of writing it consists of a title and nothing else. The text under it is blank, which makes it the shortest chapter in the canon by a margin that no future chapter can ever beat.

sections.heading: The title
sections.body:
The printed title is “Chaper Number New Jersey, the newest jersey, dare I say the most modern jersey I have seen yet, believe me I've seen alot of jerseys and none are as meta as this jersey”. It keeps the book's tradition of chapter titles that are really sentences ([[chapter-the-fourth]], [[dunder-mifflan-chapter]], [[chapter-maybe-seventh]]). It is also the first chapter to give itself a number-shaped word (“Number”) and then decline to say which number.

The spelling “Chaper” is kept in the printed title and is not a Wiki typo.

sections.heading: Setting the scene
sections.body: The previous chapter ends as the [[new-apple-employees|New Apple Employees]] climb into the last [[tesla-roadsters-2028|Tesla roadster]] and [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] announces: “Alright boys, its time to go to the New Jersey system”. That makes [[new-jersey-system|the New Jersey system]] the next destination, and presumably the setting of this chapter.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Unlike the other chapter titles, this heading is centred on the reading page.
- By line count it is three lines long, all of them the title.
- “Meta” appears in the title as a quality of a jersey. The book does not elaborate.

title: Scott the Woz
subtitle: Owner of a giant box made of Wii games. Enemy of the Border.

infobox.Enemies: [[the-border|The Border]], [[spamton-neo|Spamton NEO]], the Green Bay Packers (formerly)

quote.text: I usually buy apple products but Chris has turned that against me! HOW WILL I PLAY WII FIT!

lead: **Scott the Woz** is the owner of a ship made of Wii games and the host of the best-known rescue mission in the TurboGrafx 16 Sector. He is named after a real YouTuber, and the book describes only what he does in it: he arrives mid-argument on the set of [[throats-for-thought|Throats For Thought]] to report that the sky is changing colour, flies the heroes to the source in his [[wii-cube|Wii cube]], and ends the fight with [[spamton-neo|Spamton NEO]] by feeding a Sega Genesis a very specific video game.

sections.heading: Arrival
sections.body:
Scott bursts into the studio “out of breath and in a state of panic” with the line “Hey all, Scott here”. He tells [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] that “The border, its changing color!” and then that “It’s turning black!”, and finally that it is becoming “A giant Bezel.” He explains his stake in it plainly: “I usually buy apple products but Chris has turned that against me! HOW WILL I PLAY WII FIT!”

It is the first time in the canon that [[chris|Chris]] is blamed for a graphical user interface.

sections.heading: The Wii cube
sections.body: When the heroes ask why he needs their help, Scott answers “Giant orb spaceship” and is told “Fair enough.” He leads them past the target and the GameStop to [[scotts-house|his house]], where the ship waits in the backyard: “A giant box made out of Wii games.” He apologises that “It’s a bit rusty since we fought the green bay packers but it should do the job”, then calls his gang on an iPhone duo. See [[the-wozniaks|The Wozniaks]] and [[wii-cube|The Wii Cube]].

sections.heading: The Border fight
sections.body: Inside [[the-border|the Border]], Scott is struck by a “flying Kromer brick freshly bought from Costco in bulk”, while [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] films the fight for TikTok. Thinking fast, he pulls a Sega Genesis from the scene and slams a copy of [[dick-vitales-awesome-baby|Dick Vitale's Awesome Baby]] into it. The game boots, [[spamton-neo|Spamton NEO]] is ripped from his strings, and the Border's colour returns “to the tune of the Scott the woz motif.” See [[the-border-fight|The Border Fight]].

sections.heading: Aftermath
sections.body: Scott thanks Steve for the backup (“you did absolutely nothing”, and Steve accepts this as praise), phones [[officer-steelwool|Officer Steelwool]] to find [[snapchat-ghost-protocol|Snapchat: Ghost Protocol]], and later agrees to host [[walter-white|Walter White]] and [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse Pinkman]]'s propane operation in his basement, on the condition that Walter plays Wii Sports with Moh on Thursdays. See [[basement-deal|The Basement Deal]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Scott the Woz is a real YouTuber. His Wiki article describes only the character in the book; that character shares his name and, evidently, his feelings about Wii games.
- His “motif” is how the Border's colour is restored, which implies the Border responds to musical cues. Nobody else in the canon has had a motif.
- He lives in Ohio, which is where [[corner-store-ohio|the corner store]] also is. Fans have not yet drawn the map.

title: The Wozniaks
subtitle: Four guys, one Wii box.

infobox.Members: [[jerry-attricks|Jerry Attricks]], [[rex-mohs|Rex Mohs]], [[jerry-jab|Jerry Jab]]; later [[walter-white|Walter White]] and [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse Pinkman]] (by arrangement)

lead: **The Wozniaks** are the crew of the [[wii-cube|Wii cube]]: [[scott-the-woz|Scott the Woz]] and the three associates he calls before leaving Ohio. The name is used once, in the sentence “As the apple employees went into the roaders and the wozniaks went into the wii cube”, which is also the only place the book calls the heroes “the apple employees” (see [[new-apple-employees|The New Apple Employees]]).

sections.heading: Formation
sections.body: Scott phones his gang from the backyard with the words “Jerry attricks, Rex mohs, Jerry jab.. we’re going back”. Two hours and a trip to Sheetz later they are in the Wii box: “Fast forward 2 hours and a trip to sheetz the gang was in the box of Wii games.”

sections.heading: Dynamics
sections.body: The crew is introduced mostly through their questions. [[jerry-attricks|Jerry Attricks]] asks “Who are these guys anyway and why is Kanye West here”. [[jerry-jab|Jerry Jab]] chooses the worst moment of the Border fight to admit that he left his Wii zapper at home. Scott's reply is cut off mid-word.

sections.heading: Walter and Jesse
sections.body: At the end of the Turbographx chapter [[walter-white|Walter]] and [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse]] join the Wozniaks' orbit when Walter proposes cooking in Scott's basement. They fly back to Ohio with the Wii box. See [[basement-deal|The Basement Deal]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- The name echoes Steve Wozniak ([[steve-wozniak|the other Steve]]) and Scott's own nickname, “the Woz”.
- The Wozniaks answer their call with a stop at Sheetz before leaving, which is a first for the canon.

title: The New Apple Employees
subtitle: The Propane Dropouts and the Propane Gang, after the merger.

infobox.Members: [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]], [[kanye-west|Kanye West]], [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]], [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]]; formerly [[walter-white|Walter White]] and [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse Pinkman]]

lead: **The New Apple Employees** is the Wiki's name for the combined crew that formed in the vault hallway of [[the-67-casino|the 6 7 Casino]] when [[kanye-west|Kanye's]] gang and [[hank-hill|Hank's]] gang discovered that they wanted the same thing: to defeat [[chris|Chris]]. The book itself calls them “the apple employees” once, in [[chapter-4-point-1]], which is as close to an official name as the canon provides.

sections.heading: History
sections.body: They hold the [[verizon-contract|Verizon contract]] and ride in [[inav|the Inav]]. In [[chapter-maybe-seventh]] they leave the casino for [[turbografx-16-sector|the TurboGrafx 16 Sector]] to sync the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]] with the [[flip-phone-covenant|Flip Phone Covenant]]. Steve's plan is to load a social app first, then roll back to 3G “right when we’re in Chris’s face”. In the updated text Steve is asked “So what’s the plan Jawbs”, and answers with that plan, which includes “fighting Elon musk, mush, and the sole nba player of the universe”.

sections.heading: The Turbographx detour
sections.body: The Inav is pulled into the studio of [[throats-for-thought|Throats For Thought]] by a giant [[ultra-hand|Ultra Hand]], they meet [[scott-the-woz|Scott the Woz]], they win [[the-border-fight|the Border Fight]], and learn from [[officer-steelwool|Officer Steelwool]] that [[snapchat-ghost-protocol|Snapchat: Ghost Protocol]] is in [[freddy-fazbears-pizza|Freddy Fazbear's Pizza]].

sections.heading: The split
sections.body: As the crew boards the roadsters, [[walter-white|Walter]] hesitates, then proposes a deal to Scott. He and [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse]] fly off to Ohio with [[the-wozniaks|the Wozniaks]], leaving [[hank-hill|Hank]] to remark “Damn son they done left us like that?!” The remaining four take the last roadster. This is the first time since [[chapter-the-fourth]] that the propane people have been divided.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- “New Apple Employees” was the Wiki's working name until the October 2026 update, when the book used the phrase “the apple employees” itself. The Wiki considers this a retroactive confirmation.
- The group has never been on the same page as [[new-crips|the New Crips]], who are trying to get the other half of the Prophecy's phone.

title: Jerry Attricks
subtitle: One of the Wozniaks.
lead: **Jerry Attricks** is a member of [[the-wozniaks|the Wozniaks]], named in the roll call “Jerry attricks, Rex mohs, Jerry jab..” when [[scott-the-woz|Scott]] calls his crew from the backyard.

sections.heading: In the canon
sections.body: Once aboard the [[wii-cube|Wii cube]], Jerry asks the question every reader has been asking: “Who are these guys anyway and why is Kanye West here”. [[kanye-west|Kanye]] answers “It’s Ye.” That is Jerry's only line, and he gets it exactly right.

title: Rex Mohs
subtitle: The second Wozniak, and possibly “Moh”.
lead: **Rex Mohs** is a member of [[the-wozniaks|the Wozniaks]], listed second when [[scott-the-woz|Scott]] phones his crew. He never speaks.

sections.heading: Moh?
sections.body: Near the end, Scott tells [[walter-white|Walter White]] that if he sets up in his basement, “you have to play wii sports with Moh on thursdays though”. The book does not say who Moh is. Most editors take it to be Rex Mohs, which makes him the only Wozniak with a standing appointment in the canon. This is a fan reading.

title: Jerry Jab
subtitle: He left his Wii zapper at home.
lead: **Jerry Jab** is the third of [[scott-the-woz|Scott's]] associates, and the one responsible for the most expensive sentence in the Border fight.

sections.heading: The Wii zapper
sections.body: In the middle of [[the-border-fight|the fight with Spamton NEO]], with grenades being teleported out of existence and Kromer bricks in the air, Jerry taps Scott on the shoulder: “Hey Scott... I know this is a bad time, but I left my Wii zapper at home..” Scott's reply is “GOD DAMN IT JER-” and is cut off by a flying [[kromer|Kromer]] brick.

title: Hector Andfriends
subtitle: Host of Throats For Thought. A ominous figure.
lead: **Hector Andfriends** (“Mr. Andfriends”) is the host of the hit TV show [[throats-for-thought|Throats For Thought]], broadcast in the TurboGrafx 16 universe. He is first seen as “a ominous figure in what seemed to be a recording studio”, and introduces himself with: “Hello everyone and its me Hector Andfriends on another episode of Throats For Thought!”

sections.heading: On air
sections.body:
He greets the heroes as “a ragtag group of galactic rebels who we will have share their throats, for thought!” and asks his first question: “Traveling around the universe, gambling NFTs, Selling propane, it seems rivals become Kirby star allies in a unlikely twist of fate, yet one of you does not have, atleast from what I see a throat! What gives?”

When [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] reveals a mechanical throat that uses “the atmosphere of the place I am in” to speak, Mr. Andfriends “breathed a sigh of relief”. He then asks the question that occupies the next two hours: would you play [[madden-nfl-08-argument|Madden NFL 08]] on Wii?

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- His knowledge of the heroes' recent history (the NFTs, the propane, the Kirby Star Allies reference) is complete, which is unusual for a host of a show about throats.
- He is last seen mid-argument. Whether the show was aired, or Scott's arrival cut the episode, is not recorded.

title: Throats For Thought
subtitle: A hit TV show in the TurboGrafx 16 universe, asking people with throats about their opinions.

infobox.Setting: A recording studio in [[turbografx-16-sector|the TurboGrafx 16 universe]]

lead: **Throats For Thought** is a talk show in the TurboGrafx 16 universe, “asking people with throats about their opinions”, according to [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]]. The heroes are taken onto an episode of it against their will, when the [[inav|Inav]] is grabbed by a giant [[ultra-hand|Ultra Hand]].

sections.heading: The episode
sections.body: [[siri|Siri]] explains the abduction: “It seems we’re being forcefully taken onto a episode of throats for thought.” After landing, the gang gathers in the airlock, walks down the ramp, and sits in what seems to be a talk-show set. [[hector-andfriends|Mr. Andfriends]] interviews them. The only follow-up question the book records is about the [[madden-nfl-08-argument|Wii version of Madden NFL 08]]. The show ends when [[scott-the-woz|Scott]] bursts in.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- The show's name plays on “food for thought”.
- ChatGPT's mechanical throat is the only throat discussed on screen.

title: The Madden NFL 08 Argument
subtitle: A full 2 hour and 4 minute argument.

infobox.Subject: Whether to play *Madden NFL 08* on Wii

lead: **The Madden NFL 08 Argument** was a debate held on the set of [[throats-for-thought|Throats For Thought]]. [[hector-andfriends|Mr. Andfriends]] asked it casually (“would you play it on Wii?”) and the book reports: “The gang then went on to have a full 2 hour and 4 minute argument about madden nfl 08 with Mr. Andfriends”.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- The argument is not transcribed. The book gives only its length and subject. For a debate that was transcribed, see [[nuh-uh-debate|the Nuh Uh–Yuh Huh Debate]].
- Madden NFL 08 is a real video game with a Wii version.
- It ends when Scott arrives, so no verdict is recorded.

title: The Ultra Hand
subtitle: A giant one.
lead: **The Ultra Hand** is the giant hand that grabs the [[inav|Inav]] after [[siri|Siri]] is told to “delta out of here”. It “appeared from the endless abyss” and “wrapped its icky fingers around the white sleek body of the Inav and started retracting”, pulling the heroes “through time and space”.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- The Ultra Hand is a real Nintendo toy from the 1960s.
- The Hand is not named in the text beyond “ultra hand”. Its owner is unknown. It takes the Inav to [[throats-for-thought|a TV studio]], so editors suspect a network.
- [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse]] screams at its arrival.

title: Gex: Enter the Gecko
subtitle: The storm of box art.
lead: ***Gex: Enter the Gecko*** is a Nintendo 64 game whose covers fill the horizon of the TurboGrafx 16 universe: an “endless stream of ripped out covers” and “the dope amount of box art”. [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] reaches out of the [[inav|Inav]] and pulls one in.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: Steve explains: “Since the premier of Borderline forever from Scott the woz. in this universe the visible horizon of this place has been filled with copy’s of Gex: Enter the gecko, in addition if you’ll notice in your vision there’s a blue border in the edge of your sight.” That blue border is [[the-border|the Border]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- *Gex: Enter the Gecko* is a real N64 game.
- Steve's explanation also mentions “Borderline forever from Scott the woz”, which the book treats as the event that filled the horizon.

title: The Border
subtitle: A blue border. A giant bezel. A boss fight.

infobox.Location: The edge of vision in [[turbografx-16-sector|the TurboGrafx 16 universe]]
infobox.Colour: Blue, then dark grey, then black, then blue again

lead: **The Border** is a blue frame “in the edge of your sight” in the TurboGrafx 16 universe, a result of the visible horizon being filled with [[gex-enter-the-gecko|Gex: Enter the Gecko]] covers. [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] notices it first; [[kanye-west|Kanye]] “became visibly tweaked out” at the idea that “im surrounded by some big blue border”.

sections.heading: The change
sections.body: [[scott-the-woz|Scott]] reports that it is changing colour, then turning black, then becoming “A giant Bezel.” As the gang runs for Scott's house, “the border got darker and darker, not yet black but a very, very, dark grey.” It is later seen as “the giant blue border suspended in space”, and two [[tesla-roadsters-2028|roadsters]] dock to it.

sections.heading: Inside
sections.body: The interior is darkness, then a clank, “a bit crunch, and the sound of pulleys rapidly approaching”. The inhabitant is [[spamton-neo|Spamton NEO]]. When he is removed, “the color started returning to the blue border to the tune of the Scott the woz motif.” See [[the-border-fight|The Border Fight]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Editors read the Border as a screen bezel. Scott's worry about Wii Fit is the book's only explanation.
- Chris is blamed for it by Scott: “By Chris! It’s becoming.. A giant Bezel.”

title: Spamton NEO
subtitle: The Secret Boss. Strung up.

infobox.Defeated by: [[scott-the-woz|Scott the Woz]] and *Dick Vitale's Awesome Baby*

lead: **Spamton NEO** is the final form of [[spamton|Spamton G. Spamton]] and the boss of [[the-border|the Border]]. He is the first form of Spamton the heroes meet in person; earlier he was only a voice on [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom's]] Windows Phone.

sections.heading: Appearance
sections.body: He arrives with “DEAR CHRIS!-”, then a verse the Wiki treats as his introduction: “SPAMTON G. SPAMTON / [his name] / I AM SECRET BOSS, / IN DELTARUNE GAME,”. The heroes “in shambles”: [[steve-jobs|Steve]]'s iGrenades are “promptly teleported out of existence”, [[kanye-west|Kanye]] drops bars on him, and [[hank-hill|Hank]] and [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse]] open fire with Glocks whose magazines keep spawning in their steam wallets.

sections.heading: Defeat
sections.body:
[[scott-the-woz|Scott]] tears out a Sega Genesis and slams [[dick-vitales-awesome-baby|Dick Vitale's Awesome Baby]] into it. “Suddenly the game started up and with a loud ‘It’s awesome baby’ (bit crunched to 32bit perfection for the audiophiles of the Mongolian empire) SPAMTON NEO got ripped from his strings and a lone SPAMTON rested on the ground.”

An echo of a basketball leaves the building, “a sign that LeBron James had left the building..”

sections.heading: Aftermath
sections.body:
The base Spamton says “DAMN [son] I DONT KNOW WHAT GOT INTO [me] LAST THING I REMEMBER I WAS [calling my dear friend] MF [vroom] AND SUDDENLY A MYSTERIOUS FIGURE IN [cybr city!!111] INJECTED ME WITH [flowers bloom in your heart]”. He does a little dance. He then sells [[steve-jobs|Steve]] a bundle of [[kromer|Kromer]] and vanishes.

The mysterious figure is not named. The basketball, though, is a clue; see below.

sections.heading: Fan theories
sections.body:
- LeBron was inside Spamton NEO. The book says only that his departure was signalled by a basketball echo. This fits [[lebron-james|LeBron]] having merged with [[elon-musk|Elon]] and joined Chris's side.
- “Flowers bloom in your heart” has not been explained.

sections.heading: Behind the scenes
sections.body:
- Spamton NEO is the secret boss of *Deltarune* Chapter 2.
- The first line of his verse is a quote from the game.

title: The Border Fight
subtitle: A battle in the black bezel of the TurboGrafx 16 universe.

infobox.Combatants: [[new-apple-employees|The New Apple Employees]] and [[the-wozniaks|the Wozniaks]] vs. [[spamton-neo|Spamton NEO]]
infobox.Decisive weapon: [[dick-vitales-awesome-baby|Dick Vitale's Awesome Baby]] on a Sega Genesis
infobox.Result: Spamton NEO defeated; the Border returns to blue

lead: **The Border Fight** is the battle between the heroes and [[spamton-neo|Spamton NEO]] inside [[the-border|the Border]]. [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] records it to upload to TikTok.

sections.heading: Sequence
sections.body:
- Steve Jobs throws iGrenades, which are “teleported out of existence”.
- Kanye West “started dropping bars on him”.
- Hank and Jesse shoot him with Glocks, “standing in stoic silence as they reloaded magazines which kept being spawned in their steam wallets”.
- [[jerry-jab|Jerry Jab]] admits he left his Wii zapper at home.
- A flying [[kromer|Kromer]] brick knocks Scott down.
- Scott pulls out a Sega Genesis and loads [[dick-vitales-awesome-baby|Dick Vitale's Awesome Baby]].
- Spamton NEO is ripped from his strings.

sections.heading: Aftermath
sections.body: The base Spamton gets up, does a little dance, and sells [[steve-jobs|Steve]] some Kromer. [[officer-steelwool|Officer Steelwool]] is called. See [[freddy-fazbears-pizza|Freddy Fazbear's Pizza]].

title: Dick Vitale's Awesome Baby
subtitle: The weapon that works on Spamton NEO.

infobox.Effect: Rips Spamton NEO from his strings

lead: **Dick Vitale's Awesome Baby** (the book's spelling of the college basketball game) is the game Scott slams into a Sega Genesis to end [[the-border-fight|the Border Fight]]. The game boots with a shout of “It’s awesome baby”, “bit crunched to 32bit perfection for the audiophiles of the Mongolian empire”.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- The real game is *Dick Vitale's "Awesome, Baby!" College Hoops* for the Genesis, which makes the cartridge a basketball item. The book may be implying that it is effective against [[lebron-james|LeBron James]].
- “32bit” is anachronistic: the Genesis is a 16-bit console.
- The Mongolian empire has not otherwise been mentioned, but it does have audiophiles.

title: The Wii Cube
subtitle: A giant box made out of Wii games.

infobox.Condition: A bit rusty since the Green Bay Packers

lead: **The Wii Cube** (“the Wii box”, “the wii cube”) is [[scott-the-woz|Scott the Woz's]] ship. It is “A giant box made out of Wii games” in his backyard. Scott explains: “It’s a bit rusty since we fought the green bay packers but it should do the job.”

sections.heading: Journeys
sections.body:
It takes the heroes to [[the-border|the Border]], “suspended in space”, and then flies with them back to Ohio.

For comparison, see [[inav|the Inav]], which has a mansion inside.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - Scott says only his ship “can board the border”.

title: Scott's House
subtitle: Ohio. A backyard with a ship in it.

infobox.Landmarks: The Target, the GameStop, a Sheetz

lead: **Scott's House** is the home of [[scott-the-woz|Scott the Woz]] in Ohio. The heroes run to it from the studio, “past the target, and the GameStop”, and enter the backyard to find the [[wii-cube|Wii cube]].

sections.heading: The basement
sections.body: [[walter-white|Walter White]] proposes cooking propane in the basement. Scott agrees on the condition that Walter plays Wii Sports with Moh on Thursdays. See [[basement-deal|The Basement Deal]]. [[hank-hill|Hank]] says “for the love of propane”.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- Steve Jobs tells Scott: “anything for ohio rizz gamestops”.
- Ohio also contains [[corner-store-ohio|the corner store]] and [[united-streets-of-ohio|the United Streets of Ohio]], which seems to be an area of heavy sightseeing for the canon.

title: The Basement Deal
subtitle: Propane, but in a basement.

infobox.Terms: Money and free propane for the grill, in exchange for The Internet and Scott's support of Walter's “Cooking”
infobox.Condition: Play Wii Sports with Moh on Thursdays

lead: **The Basement Deal** is an arrangement between [[walter-white|Walter White]] and [[scott-the-woz|Scott the Woz]] in the last pages of [[chapter-4-point-1]]. Walter “hesitated for a moment”, then tells [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse]]: “this universe I bet has a bunch of hungry gamers who want propane and methanfedimene.”

sections.heading: Terms
sections.body: Walter asks Scott: “how would you feel if we set up shop inside your basement, we would provide you with money and free propane for your grill, all we’d need is The Internet and You to support our.. Cooking.” Scott: “you have to play wii sports with Moh on thursdays though.” Jesse: “Sounds like a deal yo.” They “dabbed up”, hopped into their roadster, and flew to Ohio with the Wii box.

sections.heading: Consequences
sections.body:
[[hank-hill|Hank]] is left behind with the other Apple employees: “Damn son they done left us like that?!” Another voice answers: “Its for the love of propane thats right boyh”, said Hank Hill.

As far as the Wiki can tell, this is Walter White's first partnership with the owner of a ship made of Wii games.

title: Officer Steelwool
subtitle: Scott's associate. Knows where Snapchat is.
lead: **Officer Steelwool** (“officer steel wool”) is an associate of [[scott-the-woz|Scott the Woz]] who “might know of the whereabouts of Snapchat ghost protocol”. Scott says he is assuming the heroes mean the Prophecy.

sections.heading: The call
sections.body: Scott phones him after [[the-border-fight|the Border Fight]]. Steelwool answers “Hello? Hello hello?” and plays a recorded message: the Night 1 phone call from *Five Nights at Freddy's*, recited almost word for word, from “Uh, I wanted to record a message for you, to help you get settled in on your first night” to “Alright, good night.” The message names the place: [[freddy-fazbears-pizza|Freddy Fazbear's Pizza]]. [[kanye-west|Kanye]]: “We finna pull up on those robots brotha”.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- The recording describes animatronics, the Bite of '87, and the fact that the only parts of the night guard seen again would be their eyeballs and teeth. The book does not comment on this.
- Steelwool's own contribution to the call is the first word, “Hello?”

title: Freddy Fazbear's Pizza
subtitle: A magical place for kids and grown-ups alike.
lead: **Freddy Fazbear's Pizza** is where [[snapchat-ghost-protocol|Snapchat: Ghost Protocol]] is located, according to the phone message that [[officer-steelwool|Officer Steelwool]] plays for the heroes. The book concludes: “Well that solves it, Snapchat: Ghost protcol is in.. Freddy Fazbears Pizza”.

sections.heading: The recording
sections.body: The message is the Night 1 call from *Five Nights at Freddy's*. It welcomes the night guard to “a magical place for kids and grown-ups alike, where fantasy and fun come to life”, notes that “Fazbear Entertainment is not responsible for damage to property or person”, and warns that animatronics will try to stuff you in a suit.

sections.heading: Status
sections.body: The Apple Employees' plan is to “pull up on those robots”. The book moves on to [[new-jersey-system|the New Jersey system]] before the pizza place is reached, so the Wiki lists it as the next stop for Snapchat.

title: The New Jersey System
subtitle: The newest jersey.
lead: **The New Jersey System** is where the [[new-apple-employees|New Apple Employees]] are going at the end of [[chapter-4-point-1]]. [[steve-jobs|Steve]] says: “Alright boys, its time to go to the New Jersey system”. It is the setting of [[chapter-new-jersey|Chapter Number New Jersey]], which at present consists of a title.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- The chapter heading calls it “the newest jersey, dare I say the most modern jersey I have seen yet”.
- It is not stated why the system is chosen, or whether it has anything to do with [[freddy-fazbears-pizza|Snapchat's location]].

title: Tesla 2028 Roadsters
subtitle: Two, from Elon.
lead: **The Tesla 2028 Roadsters** are two vehicles that [[scott-the-woz|Scott]] has en route from [[elon-musk|Elon Musk]]: “I have 2028 Tesla Roaders enroute to our location from musk, I just texted him their on their way.” They “docked to the border” as “2 SpaceX Tesla 2028 roadsters”.

sections.heading: Elon
sections.body:
The gang is stunned: “wait your in contact with Elon?” Scott: “Yeah who do you think peer reviews his ideas, he’s pretty chill if you get to know him”. Asked whether they will summon him when they roll back to 3G, he says Elon “just plays ball for the love of the game and because he has connections, he lowkirkgenuinely doesn’t care too much”.

This is the first on-page evidence that Elon Musk can be reached by text. The Wiki notes it is not [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]].

sections.heading: Use
sections.body: One roadster takes [[walter-white|Walter]] and [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse]] with the Wii box to Ohio. The other takes the remaining four: Steve, Kanye, ChatGPT and Hank. Steve is notified of a purchase in the same scene; see [[kromer|Kromer]].
